title: In A Major Way Album Cover
coreRelationships: The watch serves as a prominent frame for the internal photographic scene.
The typography is layered above the watch, establishing a clear hierarchy.
The deep purple background provides a stark contrast to the metallic gold of the watch.
The 'Parental Advisory' label acts as a small, distinct element in the corner.
reuseFormula: Recreate the central gold, diamond-encrusted watch with an internal photographic scene of a man cooking. Overlay the specified metallic and outlined typography for the main title and subtitle, and include the 'Parental Advisory' label. Use a textured deep purple background.
